model.map_distribution: independent uniform unrestricted binary linear (M+1)-by-(M+1) matrix at every bit position
model.shared_setup: the sampled matrices are reused for every codeword

probability_space: one BA-3 draw for the active row, its uniform coordinate permutation, the independent uniform row permutation in every transposed region, and the independent RandomStepConv matrices
limitations: The BA spectrum is averaged over its two interleavers.
The calculation uses nearest binary64 rather than outward arithmetic.
No implementation-cost claim is made for the dense random step maps.
